newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Daewoo, Stellar Global bid for Bulgaria's Chimco.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo, Stellar Global bid for Bulgaria's Chimco.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo and Stellar Global Corporation of Canada have bid for a 57 percent stake in Bulgarian chemical fertiliser producer Chimco, the Privatisation Agency said on Thursday.
The Agency, which opened their bids on Thursday morning, will negotiate with the two companies to select the buyer.
The Agency set a minimum price of $100.2 million for the stake after Daewoo's previous bid for the plant in the town of Vratsa was deemed too low.

Daewoo set up a local subsidiary in Bulgaria in 1992. Last year, it bought 67 percent of Sofia's luxury Sheraton Sofia Hotel Balkan for $22.3 million, pledging to invest some $5 million in it over five years.
Daewoo's Bulgarian subsidiary is also re-exporting disassembled Daewoo cars from Bulgaria to Russia and other former Soviet republics.
